78603.subject: Generate your Recovery Kit before 10 Sep
78603.body:
Login is moving to
Passkey. Make sure you have a Recovery Kit, so you never lose
your Wallet access.

*****************************************************************
KEEP ACCESS TO YOUR
WALLET.
*****************************************************************

Hi
Novosadov oleh,

Logging in on Socios.com
is moving to Passkey, so now's the moment to make sure you can
never be locked out.

You already use your
Passkey, the Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN you created when
setting up your wallet to log in confirm all your wallet
transactions inside the app. To ensure you never lose access when
switching or upgrading devices, make sure cloud syncing is turned
on:

* iPhone: Turn on iCloud
Keychain in your Apple
settings.
* Android: Turn on Google
Password Manager in your Google
settings.
As long as cloud
syncing is active, your Passkey should automatically transfer to
your new phone.

Your Recovery Kit is
the backstop for everything else. If you ever lose access to your
Passkey, it's the only way back into your
account.

We noticed you haven't
generated yours yet. Two steps, and they work
together:

* Generate your Recovery
Kit. It's the only way to restore your Socios.com Wallet if you
lose your Passkey. Go to Account Management > Recovery Kit >
Generate, then store it somewhere
safe.
* Verify your email
address. If you ever lose your Passkey, you will receive a link
to your verified email address, and that link gives you access to
recover your Wallet with the Recovery Kit. With a verified email
and a valid recovery kit you get yourself back in, in minutes.
Verify your email in Account Management
now.
Starting 10
September 2026, your Passkey becomes your main way to log in, so
a Recovery Kit means you're covered, whatever happens to your
device.

Socios.com cannot
restore your wallet or assets if both your Passkey and Recovery
Kit are lost.
